title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：theft　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 theft 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the clerk ① reported the theft that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the reporting was the whole of the month. The ② theft, meaning the stealing itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a theft, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ theft in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ theft at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A theft, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the theft was the whole of the matter, meaning the crime and not the stealing. The ⑥ theft, meaning the crime and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; theft, he said, is either something you report or the only word that means both a stealing and a crime. He said the crime is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ theft had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ theft of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; theft, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ theft I remember is the stealing noted in the file, which closed in 1990 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ theft, my mother said in 1992, is the only stealing that improves by being noted; every theft, she said, is a crime that has agreed to look like a stealing. She said the crime was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 偷窃；盗窃案（指办事处里每一起旁边的那一起）
B. n. 偷窃；盗窃案（指那起偷窃本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：report the theft 报案这一起偷窃
D. n. 偷窃；盗窃案（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 偷窃之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的偷窃之事）
F. n. 偷窃；盗窃案（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一起）
G. n. 偷窃、罪过（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 罪过（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reported the theft that no applicant in the office would have noted
The theft, meaning the stealing itself and not the stamp
the theft at the far counter
the theft was the whole of the matter
the theft had become a line in a file
The theft of the whole thing
A theft, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: report the theft 意为“报案这一起偷窃”，1983 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一起偷窃做了一遍。
theft 意为“偷窃；盗窃案”，指那起偷窃本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
theft 意为“偷窃；盗窃案”，指办事处里每一起旁边的那一起，每一起旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
theft 意为“偷窃；盗窃案”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
theft 意为“偷窃、罪过”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这起罪过就是那件事的全部。
theft 意为“罪过”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那起偷窃，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
theft 意为“偷窃；盗窃案”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一起，到 1988 年这一起成了卷宗里的一行。
theft 意为“偷窃之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的偷窃之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
theft 意为“偷窃；盗窃案”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一起，1990 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一起。
theft 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，偷窃是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的偷窃。
